verdict.rationale: Shortcut presents itself as producing AI-generated work all the way to pull requests ('idea to spec to PR'), so whether those AI-authored commits can be required to carry the engineer's SSH or GPG signature is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence mentions commit signing, SSH/GPG keys, or any enforcement of signed commits. The GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket integrations and MCP connectivity are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key
